newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close flat near end of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close flat near end of settlement.

text.p: Delhi shares ended flat on Wednesday after a late selling spree by punters and investors ahead of the end of the current account erased early gains, brokers said.
Friday is the last day of the current settlement in Delhi.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 0.07 point higher at 712.60. The sensex had spurted to 716.94 in early trade.
